scenarios.scenario: Legacy API alias drifts from canonical handler during rename
scenarios.rationale: For the reviewed two handlers, direct re-exports and strict imported-function identity assertions pass in the current focused unit run. This rules out duplicated-handler drift within that exact scope, not all API correctness.

scenarios.scenario: Brand rewrite drops repeated, encoded, empty or literal-plus query values
scenarios.rationale: Four preserved public redirect tests pass under the explicit ordered decoded-parameter contract, including independent expected ordered entries and unchanged 308/path assertions. Raw signed-query byte identity is explicitly not promised; earlier raw failures remain retained.

scenarios.scenario: Signed-out browser renders either protected product body
scenarios.rationale: Both signed-out local Playwright cases passed final homepage redirects; protected source checks both identity and admin permission. This conclusion is limited to tested signed-out conditions and current unchanged guards, not a live authorization audit.

scenarios.scenario: Waitlist rebrand changes serialized types or calls a live provider during contract tests
scenarios.rationale: Six client and seventeen handler tests preserve exact magic-chat POST and all three existing audience request types; Resend/fetch are mocked. Invalid request/missing configuration/provider failure behavior is asserted without real contacts or email sends.

scenarios.scenario: Current-brand artwork replacement destroys legacy source assets
scenarios.rationale: Original raster hashes and the three How It Works PNG hashes match retained before manifests; current consumers were repointed or removed without original deletion. Before bytes for the two documentation changes are separately preserved. No global reset, clean, stage or commit occurred.

scenarios.scenario: Unexamined deployed RLS/EXECUTE grants, non-admin role escalation or API-key RPC behavior
scenarios.rationale: Explicitly deferred/out of scope under user choices; no live-provider probe or new role session is authorized or claimed. Existing static guards and signed-out tests are not substituted for deployed permission proof.

scope: Phase 01 local compatibility/presentation evidence only; not a production penetration test
deferralReason: User excluded live-provider RPC probing and npm lookup; no auth-control implementation change or deployment is part of this rebrand
